column1: # Lamakan Desert: Mia is shaken by the Manticore and briefly lets her anger show.

column3: I wanted it dead after\nwhat it did. I only wish\nit had suffered less.{end_wait}
Mia... you seemed glad\nwhen it fell. I've never\nheard you speak that way.{end_wait}
I know. I let my anger get\nthe better of me. That\nisn't who I want to be.{end_wait}
I'm all right, Isaac. Just\ngive me a moment. I won't\nlet this change me.{end_wait}
You don't have to carry\nwhat happened here alone,\nMia. We're with you.{end_wait}
